semantics.model: Each observation is one model × cohort aggregate; each model has equal weight. Separate cohorts; no Gaussian fit.
semantics.game: Each observation is one saved completed candidate game. Histogram reference is selectable B or c4, never independent model samples.
semantics.game_marker: Arithmetic mean of per-game metric, not pooled VP/Main. Original pooled ratio displayed separately.
semantics.percentile: Midrank: (lower + 0.5 equal)/N; selected mean in game distribution is NOT a percentile among models.
semantics.quantile: Linear interpolation on sorted observations at (N-1)*p. Histogram last bin includes maximum.
